description: Right-click in the rename field opens the Cut/Copy/Paste menu behind the rename popover.
expected_report: While renaming (F2), right-clicking the filename field opens the text context menu underneath the rename popover, so its items are hidden. Expected: the menu appears above the popover.
difficulty: Occlusion: the menu is only partly visible behind the popover.
